name: @aletheia-works/vivarium-docs
description: Documentation site for Vivarium, built with rspress.

scripts.generate: bun run generate-repro-chrome && bun run generate-validators && bun run generate-index && bun run generate-repro-pages && bun run generate-repro-i18n && bun run generate-project-pages && bun run generate-site-stats
scripts.dev: bun run generate && bun run prebuild-repro && rspress dev
scripts.test:unit: bun run generate-validators && bun run generate-repro-pages && bun test scripts/__tests__
